availability: Activated Splunk Cloud capability; not available on Splunk Enterprise.

input.transport: HTTP Event Collector or Splunk forwarder
input.selected_format: structured HEC JSON event envelope with event payload, HEC metadata, and optional flat fields metadata
input.endpoint_path: Use the structured HEC event endpoint advertised for the connected tenant. The current Ingest Processor documentation identifies HEC input and port 8088 but does not specify a /services/collector/raw input contract; do not configure /raw for these JSON envelopes.
input.indexer_acknowledgement: Disabled on HEC tokens feeding Ingest Processor; useACK=false for forwarders feeding Ingest Processor.
input.event_body_contract: The structured HEC event object remains the event body. SPL2 changes only destination index metadata; runtime semantic preservation must be confirmed with product preview and indexed readback.

destination.index_routing: The pipeline sets the target index explicitly. Confirm the index exists and the connected service account can write to it.
destination.delivery_guarantee: Ingest Processor provides no data delivery guarantees; high backpressure or a prolonged destination outage can cause data loss.

pipelines.partition_scope_note: Configure this condition in the Ingest Processor pipeline builder; this is the source partition, not a SPL2 where filter. Confirm stream:netflow is registered as a source type with the intended event breaking rules.

Configure this condition in the Ingest Processor pipeline builder; this is the source partition, not a SPL2 where filter. Confirm atlas:o11y_health is registered as a source type with the intended event breaking rules.
pipelines.operator_requirement: Set adm_index_o11y_health to index=atlas_o11y, or change this template target index and the macro together before activation.

behavior.masking_reason: The selected traffic tuple, ports, timestamps, sampling/counters, health identity, metric values, and completion evidence are all consumed by Atlas; no field in these selected contracts can be masked without reducing required evidence.
behavior.unmatched_input: A valid event that matches no applied partition is sent to the non-configurable splunk_indexer destination. Preserve the source index or set an explicit target index so unmatched data does not fall through to the platform default index.
behavior.pipeline_filtered_input: Dropped; these templates contain no filtering command.
behavior.malformed_hec_input: Not assigned an unmatched-partition fallback by this profile. Validate HEC rejection and processor/input counters on the selected tenant version.
behavior.qualification_note: An Ingest Processor preview and Splunk Cloud indexed readback are required before claiming runtime equivalence.

serialization.event_json_byte_order_preservation: unqualified; canonical fixture hashes cover JSON semantics only
serialization.duplicate_json_key_runtime_behavior: unqualified; the offline fixture validator rejects ambiguous duplicate keys
serialization.offline_null_contract: Every selected health metric fixture explicitly carries these nulls; the offline validator enforces key presence and JSON null values.
serialization.runtime_null_roundtrip: unqualified; verify explicit nulls in product preview and indexed readback before qualification.

scope_exclusions: All other sourcetypes outside the two selected partitions
excluded_input_handling: Route excluded sources directly or separately qualify the product-specific unmatched/default route before sending them through the same processor input.
